meta.source: Coded from the published QP and mark scheme (J560/04, Thursday 16 May 2024). Derived metadata only — question numbers, marks, mark-scheme codes and skill tags. No exam question text transcribed.
meta.note: June 2024 series, despite the download folder's Nov 24 label. Coded in the same sitting as OCR-JUN24-F-P1 so the crossover items carry identical tags. OCR INTERLEAVES its shared questions rather than blocking them: J560/01 q19, q20, q21, q22 and q27 reappear here as q1, q2, q4, q5 and q7, with brand-new questions between them. Marks match item for item (3, 3, 9, 3, 3 — 21 of the 100). No per-question total is printed, so the whole-paper sum against the published 100 is the only check, and this file passes it.

coding_notes: q1, q2, q4, q5 and q7 are J560/01 q19, q20, q21, q22 and q27 and carry identical skill tags, kinds and mark splits to that file, by design.
mark_split is derived from OCR's part totals and partial-credit routes rather than quoted; see OCR-JUN24-F-P1 for the reasoning.

q3 tagged simultaneous_equations first, then mean and range: the two equations come from a mean and a range, but four of the five marks are forming and eliminating, and filing the item under Probability and Data would be wrong.
q10 coded as ONE 3-mark row, as the paper prints it — no (a)/(b) is printed even though the mark scheme splits 1 for naming the error and 2 for the correct solution.

q13a tagged inverse_functions rather than function_machines. The machine is the presentation, but the mark is for an algebraic expression for the inverse, which is what separates this Higher item from the Foundation 'find the input' items that sit on function_machines (e.g. OCR-JUN25-F-P3 q10aii).

q18bii and q18biii tagged gradient_of_a_curve, the node added 2026-09-04: a tangent drawn to a distance-time curve to read a speed, and then a statement justified by the gradient steepening. q18a and q18bi stay on kinematic_graphs — an area under a speed-time graph and a chord-average speed read straight off two points.
q17c tagged conditional_probability then box_plots: the answer is a conditional probability whose two quartile counts come off the box plot.
q6 tagged exterior_angles, the node whose own territory the interior/exterior relation is, with solving_linear_equations for the equation the mark scheme forms.
